title: Oracle: the gateway keeps supplemental-logging state until it restarts
symptom: INGESTION_GATEWAY_CDC_NOT_ENABLED: "Primary Key supplemental logging is not enabled on this table." after primary-key logging was added and checked in DBA_LOG_GROUPS. Later updates kept failing.
cause: The gateway keeps the connection's logging state until it restarts.
effect: Updates fail until a restart; after the restart other tables reported the error.
fix: Restart the gateway after each logging change, then start the update.
notes: One run. The picture after the restart isn't clean: different tables failed.
